display.purpose: Hero headline only; centred, balanced, max 22ch, two lines.

statement.purpose: The one-paragraph band between hero and protocol; ink-2 with the conclusion in ink at 600.

value.purpose: Engraved quantities in the values plate (price, delay, handoff, region); tabular numerals.

numeral.purpose: Step index in the protocol, in ink-3; stands in for an icon.

lead.purpose: One paragraph under a section headline; ink-2, max 58ch.

small.purpose: Captions, hints, fine print, legal; 0.82 to 0.95rem in ink-2 or ink-3.

label.purpose: Uppercase etched labels: field labels, value dts, compare tags, porthole marker (0.72rem), caption tag (0.12em), scroll hint (0.66rem, 0.16em).

control.purpose: Pill button label; 0.9rem in the small pill.

shadows.name: pill-rest
shadows.purpose: Charcoal pill at rest; the inset line is the single catch-light.

shadows.name: marker
shadows.purpose: Translucent metal pills and tags sitting on a photograph.

shadows.name: porthole-rest
shadows.purpose: Hero porthole at rest; both terms fade to zero as it fills the viewport.

shadows.name: booking-plate
shadows.purpose: Booking plate contact shadow, on top of a hairline border.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused input: lighter recess plus a 3px mint ring.

shadows.name: header-glass
shadows.purpose: Fixed header; not a box-shadow, recorded here because it is the only blur in the system.

motion.name: duration-field
motion.purpose: Input border, shadow and background on focus.

motion.name: duration-marker
motion.purpose: Opacity crossfade between the Avant and Apres marker pills.

motion.name: scrub-track
motion.purpose: Hero scroll length; progress p = -top / (height - viewport).

motion.name: scrub-title
motion.purpose: Title, CTA and note fade (opacity 1 - pT) and drift (-24px / +18px).

motion.name: scrub-scale
motion.purpose: Porthole grows from measured rest size to min(100vw, 0.82vh) x 100svh; radius 0.42h -> 28px (0 at full width); hairline and shadow fade out.

motion.name: scrub-clean
motion.purpose: Radial mask (farthest-corner at 32% 46%) radius pC x 124% with a 24% soft edge; also fills the progress rail; marker flips at pC > 0.55.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: static frame, aspect 1.18, radius 160px, hard 50/50 split
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: hero unpins, rail and hint removed, smooth scroll off.

breakpoints.name: phone-landscape-cut
breakpoints.purpose: Below: hero background copy and vertical hint hidden. Above: photo pair and values grid go two-up.

breakpoints.name: steps-row
breakpoints.purpose: Protocol steps go three-up with left hairlines.

breakpoints.name: portrait-aspect
breakpoints.purpose: Hero background copy hidden on upright viewports.

narrative.overview:
FreshPads reads like the maintenance sheet that ships inside a precision instrument: a brushed-aluminium ground, charcoal set as if engraved into it, and one thin line of ice-mint where the machine marks progress. The page is built around a single object seen very large (the cushion) and a single gesture (scroll, and it comes clean). Everything else on the page is a plate, a hairline or a label that explains that object. Nothing competes with the photograph; the metal is the quiet that makes it legible.

The material is real, not simulated with gradients. The ground is a generated brushed raster tile (`assets/brushed.webp`, about 4% contrast, 800×160 repeat) laid over `metal`. Plates are the next lighter alloy (`metal-light`), seated with a hairline border and a long, low ambient shadow. Depth is achieved by tone and by hairlines; there is no text-shadow anywhere in the stylesheet and no bevelled plate. Controls alone carry a one-pixel white catch-light along their top edge, the way a machined button catches the room.

Density is low and the rhythm is editorial: one message per band, one headline per section, generous section padding driven by viewport height. Type is a tight grotesk pairing: Familjen Grotesk at an unusual 560 weight with negative tracking for display, Hanken Grotesk for everything read at length. Color is nearly absent: the whole text field is achromatic, and mint appears only as a hairline rule, a progress rail, a slider handle, a focus ring and a 7px dot. The photos (a hand, a teal bedsheet, grey-then-white mesh) are the only saturated things on the page, which is the point.
keyCharacteristics: Brushed silver raster ground; lighter plates set on hairlines, not on bevels
Charcoal ink, two tinted greys for secondary and tertiary text; no pure black, no pure white text surfaces
Ice-mint confined to hairlines, the rail, the slider handle, focus rings and a dot; never used as text
Familjen Grotesk 560 display with -0.028 to -0.035em tracking; Hanken Grotesk body at 1.0625rem/1.55
Charcoal pill as the only button; translucent metal pills as photo markers
Cushion-shaped porthole (radius 0.42 × height) and 22px plates; 999px pills
Scroll-scrubbed before/after in the hero; drag-and-keyboard slider as the proof
Authored SVG icons at 1.5px stroke, round caps; four icons total, no icon set

rules.name: The Hairline-Only Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint is a line, a ring or a dot, never a letterform and never a surface behind letterforms. If a new element needs mint text, the answer is charcoal text next to a mint dot (as the "Après" marker does).

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is `ink-2`/`ink-3`, which are mixed toward the metal's blue-grey, not neutral greys and not opacity on ink. Text is never set in `rgba(ink, 0.x)`.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest value on the page is `ink` (#1b1d20). Pure black and pure white appear only as the 1px catch-light and the white text inside charcoal pills.

rules.name: The 560 Rule
rules.body: Display and headline weight is 560, not 500 and not 600. Titles at 1.25rem and below step up to 600; the statement band and numerals step down to 500. Nothing display-sized is ever bold (700).

rules.name: The Tightening Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens with size: -0.015em at title, -0.022em at statement, -0.028em at headline, -0.035em at display, -0.04em on bare numerals. Labels run the other way, 0.12–0.16em open, uppercase, 0.66–0.72rem.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Every text block has a ch cap: 22ch display, 18ch headline, 26ch statement, 58ch lead, 44ch step text, 60ch fine print. No paragraph runs the full container.

rules.name: The Contact Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset 30–40px down, blurred 60–80px and spread −30 to −50px, in ink at ≤0.6 alpha. They describe a plate resting on metal, not floating above it. No shadow is ever cast upward or sideways.

rules.name: The One Catch-Light Rule
rules.body: Depth on a control is a single 1px inset white line along the top edge (14–16% on charcoal, full white on metal). No second highlight, no inner bevel, no emboss on text.

dos: **Do** set every display and headline in Familjen Grotesk at 560 with tracking between -0.028em and -0.035em; step titles at 600, statements and numerals at 500.
**Do** keep the brushed ground as the raster tile over `metal` (800×160 repeat, about 4% contrast); plates are flat `metal-light` on a 1px `line` hairline.
**Do** confine mint to the 2px rule, rail and handle, the focus ring, the selection highlight and the 7px dot; use `mint-ink` only for the caret, the focused border and the check icon.
**Do** label photographs with translucent metal pills (92% `metal`, white catch-light, 1px contact shadow) and give every "Après" its dot.
**Do** express quantities (price, delay, region) as engraved values in a hairline-gutter plate with a small `ink-3` qualifier; unknowns read "—" plus "à confirmer".
**Do** author icons as inline SVG at 1.5px stroke with round caps, sized 20–24px (44px for the confirmation mark).
**Do** cap measures (18–26ch for display sizes, 44–60ch for reading sizes) and balance or pretty-wrap headings and leads.

**Do** keep the contact-shadow recipe (30–40px y, 60–80px blur, −30 to −50px spread, ink ≤0.6) and the single top catch-light on controls; use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for transforms and 0.2–0.4s durations.
donts: **Don't** set text in mint, `mint-ink` or any tinted colour; text is `ink`, `ink-2` or `ink-3` (plus `error-text` in validation).
**Don't** add text-shadows, inner bevels, emboss or a second highlight line; depth is a hairline, a tonal step and one contact shadow.
**Don't** replace the raster ground with a CSS gradient or a flat fill, and don't put the tile on plates.
**Don't** introduce a second button style (outline, ghost, coloured). One charcoal pill; secondary actions are underlined text.
**Don't** use icon cards, icon bullets or an icon set in the protocol or anywhere else; steps are numeral + title + text.
**Don't** use pure black (#000) for text or fills, or opacity on `ink` for secondary text.
**Don't** render a photograph square or unframed; every image is clipped at 22px or by the porthole and carries the 1px inset hairline.
**Don't** split the hero into copy-left / product-right or add a badge row; the hero is headline, porthole, pill, one line.
**Don't** invent values for price, delay, city, handoff or the contact address; they are placeholders until confirmed.
**Don't** present the synthetic "after" (`photos/clean*.webp`) as a photograph; it stays labelled "simulation" in the marker and the fine print until a real after in the same framing replaces it.
